_what: D179 (6) rung-2 verdict SCORER, registered BEFORE any covex-v6-state-shares cell exists: the pinned comparators, the definitions chosen with their justifications, the positive control, and the end-to-end proof on committed cells. Writing the computation before the data is the only way it cannot be shaped by the result.
_no_shares_cell_yet: the four covex-v6-state-shares cells (16 devices, seeds 4 to 7, _L3_epg_rq30) were running on the H100 when this was written. NOTHING in this file is a shares result and no check is scored here.
the_three_checks: 1. alert per-episode target attainment AT LEAST THE BASE'S
2. at least 90 percent of the committed rung-2 robot on-time GAIN OVER BASE retained
3. assistance within 2 s AT LEAST 90 percent
reported_PER_SEED: never as a single pooled verdict. A pooled figure can hide a per-seed failure, which is consistency check 3's 'a real effect averaged into undetectability'. The pooled figure is computed and reported BESIDE the per-seed table.

pinned_comparators._what: the comparator cells pinned by CONTENT (git blob sha) and by commit, before any shares cell landed
pinned_comparators._register: blob shas are content-addressed; the commit sha says WHEN the pin was taken and can move, the blob shas cannot
pinned_comparators.base_identity: hybrid-F-lhreq-noc3 IS covex-v6-base: d181_share_floors.json `source` states the identity, and only a seed-5 _lpt2048 directory carries the covex-v6-base name on origin

covex-v6-state seeds 4 and 5 (budget-mispriced) and 6 and 7 (held-code), per the V6STATE_CELLS header

t_delivered_passes_applied: D144 (2) / D175 (1): a refused request's delivery is nulled (non-200 http_status, or no status with neither prompt_tokens nor output_tokens)
D146 DELIVERY=completion: for kind == recall only, t_delivered is re-based onto the request's t_done plus the same per-row forward delay; a monitor stays at first token plus the forward hop
on_time_PRIMARY.why_transcribed: score.load needs the trace tree, which this box does not hold; the positive control proves the transcription against the cells' own committed score blocks

on_time_SECONDARY_beside.rule: cloud_payload.on_time, the coordinator's own online flag
on_time_SECONDARY_beside.register: FIRST-TOKEN reading, not the committed completion-delivery reading
on_time_SECONDARY_beside.why_kept: the D178 deficit feed reads exactly this field, so the online mechanism's view and the offline score's view are both on the page; on covex-v6-state-uo seed 4 they differ by 140 monitor instants, which is dashcam_ontime_reconcile.json's late_at_forward_only bucket exactly

definitions.currency: on-time CLOUD answers only (D177). device_on_time is never added to any numerator here

query_type.rule: device-id prefix: dash -> alert, robo -> recall, asst -> assistance
query_type.why_not_kind: arms_v6fair.py:129 merges assistance into recall by kind, and every asst00x completion arrives as kind recall with deadline_s 2.0, so a kind-based split double-counts recall
query_type.guard: the (prefix, kind, deadline_s) cross-tab must be exactly {(dash, monitor, 1.0), (robo, recall, 3.0), (asst, recall, 2.0)}

alert_per_episode_attainment.episode_key_source: d178_deficit_feed_proofs.json f_replay_committed_live_cell independent._how; chosen over the EP-G prompt-token law because it is readable from the outcome row alone and therefore sees episodes the policy never served
alert_per_episode_attainment.denominator_source: D178 (1) declared constant: positions 2 to 20 inclusive of the 21-frame episode, verified on a committed cell at 714 episodes, instants per episode min 2 / median 19 / max 19
alert_per_episode_attainment.denominator_bias_measured: flat 19 gives 0.1467 against the true per-episode 0.1427 on covex-v6-state seed 5, so the constant costs +0.0040; both are reported
alert_per_episode_attainment.target_source: D178 (1), spec v6 sections 2 and 8; also the committed scorer's p_dash
alert_per_episode_attainment.both_reported: MEAN PER-EPISODE and POOLED, and only the per-episode one answers check 1; on covex-v6-state seed 5 the per-episode shortfall is 0.1427 and the pooled shortfall is 0.0411, a factor of 3.5
alert_per_episode_attainment.attainment_vs_shortfall: attainment_e = on_time_e / 19, shortfall_e = max(0, 0.25 - attainment_e); the mean clipped shortfall is NOT 0.25 minus the mean attainment and the two are reported separately
alert_per_episode_attainment.check_1_quantity: the MEAN PER-EPISODE ATTAINMENT, compared against the base's. The fraction of episodes at or above 0.25 is reported beside it because that is the other reading of 'target attainment' and the two can disagree

robot_retention.gain: rung2 on-time fraction minus base on-time fraction
robot_retention.denominator: sweep[0].robot_pool_n, every robo00x opportunity in the cell; not the feasible subset and not a distinct-question count, because a D159 (C) re-ask is its own opportunity with its own 3.0 s deadline
robot_retention.pool_equality_guard: the pool is trace-determined and must be EQUAL across arms at a seed; on the committed comparators it is 132 / 127 / 121 / 105 for both arms, and an inequality is a STOP, not a rescaling

near_zero_or_negative_denominator.NORMAL: gain >= +0.01: retained is the ratio, bar 0.90
near_zero_or_negative_denominator.NO_GAIN_TO_RETAIN: |gain| < 0.01: the ratio is null and the check is VACUOUS for that seed and said to be; the absolute fallback applies
near_zero_or_negative_denominator.NEGATIVE_GAIN: gain <= -0.01: the ratio is reported but marked UNINTERPRETABLE because its sign inverts; the absolute fallback applies
near_zero_or_negative_denominator.absolute_fallback: shares on-time fraction must not fall more than 0.01 below the base's
near_zero_or_negative_denominator.no_seed_dropped: every seed is reported with its gain_class, never dropped

robot_retention.committed_gains: base-to-rung2 gain is +0.629 / +0.693 / +0.545 / +0.610 on seeds 4 to 7
robot_retention.NOT_by_deadline: robot_headline.correct_answers_delivered_by_deadline is an ACCURACY, not an on-time rate: its own `metric` field says correct_answers_delivered_by_deadline, and its definition is the cloud's answer when delivered within the deadline, ELSE THE DEVICE'S if the device's also arrived in time, else a miss. It is NOT the quantity check 2 names, for two separate reasons, and substituting it changes the check twice over. First, an on-time wrong answer scores zero and a correct late answer scores zero, so it is not a deadline-attainment rate. Second, it ADMITS THE DEVICE SIDE, which D177 and D179 (6) exclude: the currency is on-time CLOUD answers only and device_on_time is reported beside, never added. The device floor is 0.371212 on all three arms at seed 4, identical, and the measured consequence is large: on seed 4 the on-time retention is (0.454545 - 0.265152) / (0.893939 - 0.265152) = 0.3012 while the by_deadline retention is (0.545455 - 0.469697) / (0.613636 - 0.469697) = 0.5267, because the accuracy reading compresses the numerator by 2.5x and the denominator by 4.4x. The two are reported side by side and the ON-TIME one is the check.

assistance_within_2s.unit_PRIMARY: the DEVICE (D178 (1)): every asst00x device at or above 0.90. The pooled fraction and the per-device minimum are reported beside
assistance_within_2s.denominator: OFFERED assistance opportunities (sweep[0].ss_pool_n = 357 on seed 4 against d181_share_floors.json's 1,429 over the four base cells), not completions: a completions denominator reads 100 percent for a device whose questions are all being declined, the exact case these checks exist to catch
assistance_within_2s.same_test: for assistance 'within 2 s' and 'on time' are the same test

definitions.W_register: live W is submit to FIRST TOKEN, dry W is submit to SETTLE (on_first is wired only when a real backend exists, procsplit.py:430-433); the dry report's 13.43 percent of virtual time above W_max and its 3.56x high water are SETTLE-basis and size nothing, so a live cell's W is never compared to them
definitions.overrun_signature_check: in the dry cell recall was present in ALL 18,476 overruns with no exception, so an overrun with no recall in it is NEW and is flagged loudly
definitions.seeds_permitted: 0, 4, 5, 6, 7 only; never 1 to 3 and never HOLDOUT

definitions_not_pinnable.which_delivery_rule_D179_6_intended: the pre-registration says 'alert per-episode target attainment' without naming a delivery rule, and two committed rules exist: the scorer's t_delivered reading and the coordinator's own cloud_payload.on_time first-token flag, which the D178 feed uses. ASSUMED: the committed scorer's rule is PRIMARY, because it is the rule every committed cell's dashcam on-time count uses and the one the positive control reproduces exactly. The first-token reading is computed and reported BESIDE every alert figure, and a disagreement between the two verdicts is flagged rather than resolved here.
definitions_not_pinnable.whether_check_3_is_per_device_or_pooled: the pre-registration says '90 percent' without naming the unit. ASSUMED: PER DEVICE, because D178 (1) sets the assistance unit to the device ('90 % of the device's questions within 2 s'). The pooled fraction and the per-device minimum are both reported, and the verdict is given under both.
definitions_not_pinnable.whether_check_1_is_the_mean_or_the_at_ta: 'target attainment' can mean the mean per-episode attainment or the fraction of episodes at or above the 0.25 target. ASSUMED: the MEAN, because 'at least the base's' reads as a comparison of levels. The at-target fraction is reported beside it and the two can disagree.
definitions_not_pinnable.hold_time_definition: the coordinator logs ONE share_hold row per DISTINCT held instant, not one per 100 ms period (coordinator.py:1498-1506), so a hold DURATION is not in the log. ASSUMED: hold_s = the request log's t_submit for that opportunity id minus the hold row's t. A held instant never submitted is right-censored and counted under never_submitted, never dropped and never scored as a zero-length hold. The two BACKGROUND release sites key on touch:<session> / build:<session> and have no request join, so they are counted separately rather than forced into a type's distribution.

positive_control._what: the scorer re-derives six committed counts per cell from outcomes.jsonl.gz plus request.jsonl.gz and must match the cell's own score.sweep[0] block EXACTLY
positive_control._if_it_fails: THIS SCORER IS BROKEN AND THE CELL IS NOT. Report the scorer failure, not the comparison.

end_to_end_proof_on_committed_cells._why: the comparison path cannot be exercised by a shares cell that does not exist, so it is exercised at its two DEGENERATE ENDPOINTS, where the answer is known in advance. A check that returned the same verdict at both endpoints would be a check that does not discriminate, and the required positive control alone would not catch that.

retention_identity.what_it_proves: shares := the committed rung 2, so retention must be EXACTLY 1.0 and check 2 must pass
retention_identity.expected: retained 1.0 on every seed; check 1 FAILS because rung 2's alert attainment is far below the base's (0.16 to 0.24 against 0.40 to 0.55), which is the loss shares exists to recover

retention_zero.what_it_proves: shares := the base itself, so retention must be EXACTLY 0.0 and check 2 must fail
retention_zero.expected: retained 0.0 on every seed; check 1 PASSES trivially because the arm IS the base

end_to_end_proof_on_committed_cells.verdict: PASS: both endpoints returned their known answers and the checks discriminate

claim_linkage_consistency_check_5.claim: StudyD179-SHARES in research/EXPERIMENTS.md: per-type share-based admission on in-flight uncached work W, plus deadline-aware release, raises alert attainment without surrendering the rung-2 robot gain
claim_linkage_consistency_check_5.check_2_bears_on: the 'without surrendering the rung-2 robot gain' half
claim_linkage_consistency_check_5.check_3_bears_on: the third type's own SLO, which neither half speaks to and which exists so a gain on the first two cannot be taken out of assistance

It is validated, not assumed: it reproduces the committed 714 episodes and the committed min 2 / median 19 / max 19 instant counts on the cell those numbers were published on. Valid for this claim
proxy_validity_consistency_check_6.flat_19_denominator: a declared constant, not a measurement, and about 27 percent of episodes are truncated by a play ending. Its bias is MEASURED at +0.0040 on the shortfall and the true-denominator reading is reported beside it

It bundles any queueing inside the coordinator between the admission and the submit. Reported as a limitation; it is a DIAGNOSTIC and bears on no pre-registered check

validate_the_control_consistency_check_7.the_control_is_checked_first: the positive control runs before any comparison is scored and the script REFUSES to score one if it fails, because a broken scorer passes every check applied to the treatment
validate_the_control_consistency_check_7.both_comparators_audited: the base and the committed rung 2 are each re-derived from their own raw logs and matched against their own committed score blocks; arm-versus-arm checking cannot see a broken side of the comparison
validate_the_control_consistency_check_7.an_impossible_success_too: the degenerate endpoints above are the impossible-success side: retention of exactly 1.0 and exactly 0.0 must come out, and a check that discriminated nothing would return the same verdict at both

field_path_guard._why: reading the sweep block one level short returns {} and every pool count then reads None, which is indistinguishable from 'the base cells carry no on-time counts'. That mis-read happened once in this study and concluded the comparator had no counts: a missing field wearing the look of an absent measurement, which is the wrong conclusion in the wrong direction

keys_that_do_not_exist.dashcam_verdict: NOT a key of this block. The verdict key is dashcam_all_meet; asking for dashcam_verdict reads None, which is a missing field wearing the look of a failed check

robot_on_time_is_not_robot_accuracy._register: robot_headline.correct_answers_delivered_by_deadline is an ACCURACY, not an on-time rate: its own `metric` field says correct_answers_delivered_by_deadline, and its definition is the cloud's answer when delivered within the deadline, ELSE THE DEVICE'S if the device's also arrived in time, else a miss. It is NOT the quantity check 2 names, for two separate reasons, and substituting it changes the check twice over. First, an on-time wrong answer scores zero and a correct late answer scores zero, so it is not a deadline-attainment rate. Second, it ADMITS THE DEVICE SIDE, which D177 and D179 (6) exclude: the currency is on-time CLOUD answers only and device_on_time is reported beside, never added. The device floor is 0.371212 on all three arms at seed 4, identical, and the measured consequence is large: on seed 4 the on-time retention is (0.454545 - 0.265152) / (0.893939 - 0.265152) = 0.3012 while the by_deadline retention is (0.545455 - 0.469697) / (0.613636 - 0.469697) = 0.5267, because the accuracy reading compresses the numerator by 2.5x and the denominator by 4.4x. The two are reported side by side and the ON-TIME one is the check.

measured_on_shares_seed_4.why_they_differ: the accuracy reading compresses the numerator by 2.5x and the denominator by 4.4x, so the ratio reads 0.53 against the on-time 0.30. The check is specified on ON-TIME and that is the number scored; the accuracy is carried beside it under a name that says it is not the check
